# clim4health: Post-Processing of Climate Data for Health Applications

## Description

Obtain, transform and export climate data including reanalyses, (seasonal) forecasts and hindcasts, and weather stations for their use in epidemiological analyses. It is organised in three sequential blocks, input (download and load data), transform (downscaling, verification, spatiotemporal aggregation and threshold-based indicators) and output (visualising and exporting data). Downscaling methods include those described in Duzenli et al. (2026) and verification methods are based on those in Manubens et al. (2018) .
